'''Kenneth Ruud''' (born 16 September 1969) is a Norwegian chemist.

He is a professor of chemistry at the [[University of Tromsø]]. He is author or coauthor of more than 150 scientific articles and director of the [[Centre for Theoretical and Computational Chemistry]] in Tromsø. In 2008, he was the recipient of the [[Dirac Medal (WATOC)|Dirac medal]] from the World Association of Theoretical and Computational Chemists. He is one of the main contributors to the [[DALTON]] program package.

In 2012 he was elected fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.dnva.no/c40213/artikkel/vis.html?tid=40214|title=Nye medlemmer 2012|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=13 November 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110927165727/http://www.dnva.no/c40213/artikkel/vis.html?tid=40214|archive-date=27 September 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Since April 2010, Kenneth is president of the [[Norwegian Chemical Society]].
<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.kjemi.no/selskapet/pdf/raadsmoete-2012.pdf|title=NKS Radsmotet 2012|publisher=[[Norwegian Chemical Society]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=13 April 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303202613/http://www.kjemi.no/selskapet/pdf/raadsmoete-2012.pdf|archive-date=3 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In February 2013, Kenneth was elected Prorektor (= Vicepresident) for research of the [[University of Tromsø]].
<ref>{{cite news|url=http://uit.no/nyheter/artikkel?p_document_id=330104&p_dim=88209|title=UiT Rektor Valg 2013|publisher=[[University of Tromsø]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=26 February 2013}}</ref>
He will take up this function on August 1, 2013.
